outputs.description: Relative energies (eV per formula unit) and in-plane lattice parameters (a and b in Å) for the chair, washboard, and bed conformations of both (CF)n and graphane monolayers, obtained from DFT variable-cell relaxations.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each submitted E_rel and lattice constant to the paper-reported gold with tolerances (E_rel ±0.005 eV or 10% relative, a,b ±0.01 Å), weighting energies 0.6 and lattice parameters 0.4. Only this monolayer DFT stage is required; all other stages from the paper (force field fitting, vdW-DF 3D stacking, MD simulations, quasirandom model) are omitted per taskability scope.

steps.description: Compare submitted relative energies to gold with tolerance, and enforce ordering C < W < B.
